blocks.text: MANILA, Philippines — Visayan consumers may face brownouts on Thursday as the grid operator has again issued a red alert for the Visayas grid due to persistently tight energy supply from outages at some coal plants and limited imports from Mindanao. In an advisory, the National Grid Corp. of the Philippines said the red alert would be in effect from 5 p.m. to 6 p.m. READ: Visayas power woes may persist until 2028, DOE chief warns A yellow alert would also be up over the grid from 3 p.m. to 5 p.m., and 6 p.m. to 9 p.m. As of 8 a.m., […]...
